stage: independent initial inspection before longer assignment or judge aesthetics

original: Patchwork turquoise, pale yellow and cream weather canopy, largely planar panels and thin straight edge seams.
Original reads as a broad symmetric tarp with central front approach notch. The support ends are very thin and do not communicate finite deck seating in the standalone snapshot.
Angular nearly flat cloth and narrow straight rod silhouettes lack cloth weight and crafted attachment depth.
target: Target keeps turquoise/yellow/cream patchwork identity while adding plump cylindrical wood supports, rounded endcaps and sewn panel edges.
Scalloped overlapped cloth makes the upper row layered and tactile; stitches and visible loops give purposeful construction detail.
Broad soft highlight transitions and restrained warm creases communicate cartoon cloth without complex texture noise.
style: Plant reference uses saturated color families, softened bevel highlights and broad coherent volume shading.
Small edge highlights and quiet shadow areas describe shape, with clear silhouette at intended size.

nativeObservations.structure: 15 four-vertex weather tarp panels, 15 eight-vertex seam meshes, 3 eight-vertex rolled hems, 1 eight-vertex ridge support, 4 thin tie ropes and 4 16-vertex knots plus root. No per-object native action assigned in inspected collection.
